name: Aurel
summary: Aurel is defined by its fully upholstered headboard and side panels, wrapped in refined premium fabric that creates a smooth, inviting contour. Stainless steel accents, finished in beautifully brushed nickel, frame the design with a quiet confidence that feels both modern and timeless. The blend of rich textile surfaces and meticulously detailed metalwork gives Aurel an unmistakably elevated presence, making it a standout centerpiece in any sophisticated interior. Headboard and bed sides all covered with fabric, SS decorative parts in nickel brushed 238x303x108 (180×200)
